stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Bahrain report new attacks as Iran says it remains open to a deal
stories.summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward the country’s energy-rich western region, while Bahrain reported a projectile strike on an industrial facility — attacks linked to Iran even as Tehran’s foreign minister said Iran remains open to a deal with the US. The strikes keep pressure on Gulf energy infrastructure while leaving a diplomatic off-ramp visible.

stories.title: Moviegoers head for the exits as quake strikes Peru
stories.summary: Newly published video shows cinema audiences rushing out mid-screening of the new Hunger Games film when a 6.7-magnitude earthquake struck Peru on Friday. Officials reported minor damage and no deaths, but the footage shows how quickly panic spreads in a country used to big quakes.

stories.title: Iran war live: US “defeated” and cannot dictate peace terms, Tehran says
stories.summary: Iran’s Supreme National Security Council says the US has been “defeated” and cannot dictate the terms of a peace deal, as strikes tied to Iran continue against US-linked targets in Bahrain and Houthi attacks press on. Al Jazeera’s live blog is tracking the conflict’s latest developments.

stories.title: Anthropic employee claims Claude helped prove the Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge says he worked with Claude to find a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, now certified by independent Lean and Mathlib computer verification; Oxford mathematician James Maynard says he is 98-99 percent certain it is correct. If it holds up, AI-assisted math has cracked a 167-year-old problem that stumped the world’s best mathematicians.

stories.title: Musk: Tesla’s AI5 computer is for Optimus robots; cars stay on AI4
stories.summary: Elon Musk said in an X reply that Tesla’s next-gen AI5 computer is earmarked for the Optimus humanoid robot, while cars will keep running AI4 — which he calls sufficient for superhuman driving. The answer settles a running owner debate over whether to wait for AI5 before upgrading from AI3.

stories.title: Bessent refuses to rule out Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia
stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent declined to rule out former CEO Jensen Huang returning to lead Nvidia, saying it depends on “where the buck stops” — after the president and key tech leaders called for his reinstatement. The comments keep the chipmaker’s leadership question open amid continuing scrutiny of Nvidia AI chip flows to China.

stories.title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
stories.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus was review-bombed after players discovered AI-generated music in a Grand Theft Auto-themed section of the game, and the developer has now removed it. It is the latest flashpoint in the fight over AI-generated assets in shipped games.

stories.title: Browns roster: 2 backups who could help take the offense to another level
stories.summary: With the Browns resting at 6-4 on their bye, Dawgs By Nature highlights backups like RB Dylan Sampson and WR Isaiah Bond who could add explosiveness to Todd Monken’s offense down the stretch. Cheap internal upgrades could matter in a tight AFC North race.

stories.title: Do the Browns play today? Cleveland’s next game after the Week 11 bye
stories.summary: Cleveland is idle in Week 11 at an unexpectedly strong 6-4, firmly holding an AFC playoff spot. The Browns return Nov. 29 to host rookie QB Fernando Mendoza and the Raiders — now a Sunday-night showcase — before a closing stretch that includes road games against the Giants, Ravens and Bengals.

stories.title: Sunday Dawg Chow: A good day to have NFL Sunday Ticket
stories.summary: The Sunday Dawg Chow rounds up the bye-week scene: Cleveland is off dreaming of playoff possibilities over the final seven games, and with five other teams also idle it is a slim slate — a good day for Sunday Ticket channel-hopping.

stories.title: Browns bye week primer: Injury updates, playoff odds, and lingering questions
stories.summary: The 6-4 Browns hit the bye healthier: safety Ronnie Hickman cleared concussion protocol, with Denzel Boston’s toe the main lingering concern. The Athletic puts Cleveland’s playoff odds at 61 percent as it controls the AFC No. 7 seed — but Todd Monken still has to fix the team’s first-quarter struggles.

stories.title: AP Top 25: UCLA and Indiana tumble; Ohio State barely hangs on
stories.summary: Ohio State barely hung on in the new AP Top 25 after Saturday’s 31-28 loss at Nebraska, while UCLA’s first defeat of the season — at Michigan — dropped the Bruins six spots to No. 10 and Indiana also fell. The poll capped a grim weekend for the Big Ten playoff hopefuls.

stories.title: Where Ohio State fell in the polls after the Nebraska loss
stories.summary: Ohio State dropped nine spots and entirely out of the US LBM Coaches Poll after losing at Nebraska, and clings to No. 25 in the AP Top 25 — its first week outside the AP top 10 in five years. At 7-4, with The Game against Michigan looming Nov. 28, the Buckeyes playoff hopes are effectively gone.

stories.title: Verstappen wins Las Vegas GP with 35 lead changes as Ferrari drivers collide again
stories.summary: Max Verstappen survived a race featuring 35 changes of the lead to win in Las Vegas — his 75th career victory and fourth of the season — after George Russell crashed chasing Kimi Antonelli late, handing Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri the podium spots. The season now heads into its Qatar-Abu Dhabi finale swing.

stories.title: Haas confirm Camara will drive for the team in final races of 2026
stories.summary: Haas confirmed Rafael Camara will race the final two Grands Prix of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi ahead of his full-time 2027 seat — even though the 21-year-old Ferrari junior currently leads the F2 standings he is now set to abandon. Two more race weekends of evaluation before his rookie F1 campaign.

stories.title: F1 presses on with Qatar and Abu Dhabi finale despite rising Middle East tensions
stories.summary: Formula 1 confirmed its season-ending races in Qatar (Nov. 27-29) and Abu Dhabi will go ahead despite rising tensions between the US and Iran in the region. The call removes the last travel and calendar uncertainty hanging over the final two weekends of the championship.

stories.title: “It’s a lack of respect”: Vasseur calls latest Hamilton-Leclerc clash “unacceptable”
stories.summary: Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur branded Charles Leclerc’s collision with Lewis Hamilton “unacceptable” after Leclerc spun his teammate into a 10-second penalty and a P10 finish — with Hamilton recovering to seventh. The Sao Paulo peace talks between the drivers clearly failed to prevent another on-track flashpoint.

stories.title: Columbus Crew rout Messi and Inter Miami to open the MLS Cup playoffs
stories.summary: The Crew opened their MLS Cup playoff run with a 3-0 road upset of defending champion Inter Miami and Lionel Messi, completing a stunning climb from last place in the Eastern Conference into the postseason. Game 2 of the best-of-three series is Friday in Columbus.

stories.title: Hit-and-run on Sawmill Rd. sends motorcyclist to hospital; driver arrested
stories.summary: A motorcyclist waiting at a green arrow onto I-270 was struck by an oncoming SUV whose driver and passenger then fled the scene; the rider was hospitalized in stable condition and the SUV driver was later arrested. Columbus police are still asking anyone with information to come forward.

stories.title: OVI crash seriously injures passenger on Columbus near east side
stories.summary: A driver was arrested on OVI charges after their car left Nelson Road near Franklin Park Street and struck a utility pole just after 12:30 a.m., leaving the passenger hospitalized in critical condition.

stories.title: Columbus community leaders demand comprehensive affordable-housing action plan
stories.summary: Columbus Urban League CEO Stephanie Hightower — whose team has fielded more than 12,000 calls since July from people at risk of losing their homes — joined NAACP and other community leaders to demand a comprehensive affordable-housing action plan from city and county officials.
